aggregate: four contiguous real 60m bars aligned to fixed UTC 4h boundary, each 4h bar closed and available only at the end of 4th 60m; never interpolate gaps or synthesize historic actual received_at

families.original_concept: Two EMA groups (3,5,8,10,12,15)/(30,35,40,45,50,60); trader-investor agreement/expansion; original author does not specify this exact robotic next-open stop.
families.prior_overlap_note: older GMMA HolyGrail mixed donor was benchmarked and is not reissued; this is standalone two-group trend transition (same indicator family, not automatically independent alpha)
families.zel_exit: after complete bar EMA15 < EMA30 exit following open; initial stop entry - 2.5*ATR14 at signal; fixed max hold 48 4h bars after entry; fixed initial stop tested intrabar adverse-first; no TP
families.zel_numeric_entry: after 240 warmup, first completed4h-bar short-min EMA>long-max EMA with previously short-min<=long-max, and long EMA60 > prior EMA60; enter next 4h open

families.original_concept: Moskowitz Ooi Pedersen 2012: 12-month sign of past excess futures return, ex ante volatility scaling, diversifying multiple futures; not a 4h crypto paper.
families.prior_overlap_note: broad time-series momentum already researched; this is fixed sign-cross/vol-normalized MOP-inspired candidate NOT 12-month original replication
families.zel_exit: after completed4h bar score <0 exit next4h open, initial stop entry - 2.0*ATR14 from signal; max hold 24 completed bars, stop-first adverse; no ranking or source overlap with prior volume-weighted daily rotation implementation
families.zel_numeric_entry: first positive crossing of own 42 completed 4h-bar (7d) log return divided by lagged rolling42-bar log-return std, previous score <=0; long next 4h open; no future input

families.original_concept: Cesar Alvarez and Larry Connors original daily long SPY: close>200-day SMA, close is 7-day closing low, buy close; close at 7-day high, sell close; no stop originally.
families.prior_overlap_note: not Connors RSI2 and not last tested 20bar wick-reclaim; shorter time-scale and stop are ZEL modifications, no source-exact daily performance claim
families.zel_exit: 7-4h-bar closing high -> next4h open exit; extra separate safety stop entry - 3.0*ATR14, max24 completed bars, original did not include stop/time cap
families.zel_numeric_entry: on 4h crypto bars only, close>4h SMA200 and close<=last7 closing values; next actual 4h open long, no same-bar reentry

limitations: published returns for futures or US equities are not crypto profits
lagged 4h model barclose is not observed historical exchange receipt
different source mechanisms still need trade-overlap assessment
reason: user requires one independent source-backed strategy per family; rank by faithful published mechanism, source availability and duplicate control, NOT retrospective profitability
trade_limit: one simultaneous position per symbol; exclude same-bar reentry; simultaneous across symbols counted separate modelled signals not account independent capital
